title: Green Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Businesses
summary: Explains the Green Rewards Card referral program: share your unique referral link; when a referred business is approved and meets a qualifying spend of at least $2,250 within 90 days from account opening, you earn 75 in referral bonus. Bonuses (up to 7 per calendar year) are credited after verification, excluding cash equivalents, certain fees, and returned transactions, and the business must apply through your link and remain in good standing through the verification date.
faqs: How do I refer a business to the Green Rewards Card referral program?
What does a referred business have to do to qualify for my $75 bonus?
